subject: Request: VPC deployment constraints + timebound commercial concession
messages:
From: Anita Singh <anita.singh@edgewave.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@edgewave.com
Date: Wed, 19 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: VPC deployment, EU residency + ask for onboarding credit

Hi Laura / Marcus,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team is excited about Redwood's inference runtimes. Before we move to procurement, a few constraints from our security and compliance teams that will determine whether we can proceed:

- Production must run in our EU VPC (Frankfurt) with data residency guarantees; no cross-border backup copying for 12 months.
- Audit window: EdgeWave requires the ability to schedule a 3-day onsite-assisted audit or remote evidence collection within 60 days notice, quarterly for the first year.
- No outbound egress to third-party analytics endpoints; only customer-managed KMS and HSM integration allowed.

Given the above, we need to understand if Redwood can accept those hosting constraints and associated contractual language. Separately, because this is a first-of-kind private deployment for us, procurement is asking for a one-time onboarding credit and a limited commercial concession (starter 20% discount for the first 3 months while we pilot).

I've attached the initial SOW and the filled security questionnaire. Can you route this to deal desk and execs for a fast decision? We are aiming to sign before the end of September if terms are doable.

Thanks,
Anita
Anita Singh
Director, Cloud Platform
EdgeWave Systems
attachments: EdgeWave_SOW_v1.pdf, EdgeWave_Security_QA_Filled.xlsx
From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: marcus_lin@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 19 Aug 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Request: VPC deployment, EU residency + ask for onboarding credit

Forwarding EdgeWave's request — they are greenlit product-wise but the ask has three nonstandard items:

1) Data residency + no cross-border backups for 12 months (legal needs to bake this into the DPA).
2) Quarterly audit rights, 60-day notice, with option for onsite-assisted evidence collection — operationally heavy.
3) Commercial: 20% one-time onboarding discount for 3 months + onboarding credit.

Rishi / Aditya — can Deal Desk confirm what we can offer here? Rishi, can you price the operational lift for quarterly audits and any HSM/KMS integration cost? Aditya, can infra commit to a Frankfurt-hosted VPC with the residency lock and the specified egress constraints?

EdgeWave is a strategic telco prospect (good long-term ARR potential). If we can move quickly they want to sign in Sept. Please advise if this needs Marcus' executive OK and any recommended guardrails we should attach to the concession.

Laura Bennett
Senior AE, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 08:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: VPC deployment, EU residency + ask for onboarding credit

Laura / team — quick summary from Deal Desk + Infra:

- Hosting: Frankfurt VPC is doable. We can offer customer-managed KMS integration; on backups we can commit to no off-region backups for 12 months if we gate it as a contractual operational constraint (adds a change-control commitment).
- Audits: quarterly 3-day windows are operationally heavy. We can support remote evidence collection with a 30-day notice as standard. Onsite-assisted audits can be allowed but limited to one per year unless charged for additional effort. We estimate ~40 engineering-hours per onsite plus security engineering coordination.
- Commercial: standard policy caps ad-hoc discounts at 10% without exec sign-off. A 20% onboarding credit for three months requires exec approval.

Suggested compromise to present for Marcus:
- Residency: accept 12-month residency lock with explicit change control clause.
- Audits: offer remote evidence within 30 days, allow one onsite-assisted audit in year one with a capped effort allowance; additional onsite audits billed at an hourly rate or via a support add-on.
- Commercial: offer a 12% onboarding credit (one-time) plus a limited $25k migration support credit. If Marcus approves, we can do 20% for 3 months but require the customer to accept limited liability for additional operational requests and a defined SLA for audit scheduling (no more than 1 onsite in first 12 months).

I've attached an internal estimate of the hours and an annotated redline request.

-Rishi
Deal Desk, Redwood Inference
attachments: DealDesk_Audit_Estimate.xlsx, redline_notes.docx
From: marcus_lin@redwood.com
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 23 Aug 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: VPC deployment, EU residency + ask for onboarding credit

Thanks for the summary. High level decision: I approve a commercial concession to accelerate this strategic telco pilot with the following guardrails — they must be explicit in the signature docs.

Approved concessions (conditional):
- Commercial: 20% discount applied to monthly hosting charges for the first 3 months (pilot period), conditional on a signed pilot SOW and an upfront commitment to a 12-month production readiness review. Also approve a one-time migration support credit of $25,000.
- Residency: agree to a 12-month EU-residency lock (Frankfurt) with clear change-control and a contractual restriction preventing automatic cross-region backups. Legal to draft DPA language.
- Audits: allow one onsite-assisted audit within the first 12 months at no additional charge, subject to a 60-day scheduling window; any additional onsite audit requests billable per Deal Desk estimate. For remote evidence collection, accept a 30-day notice SLA.
- Operational conditions: Aditya to sign off on engineering capacity for the initial provisioning window (we'll reserve two infra engineers for the pilot onboarding week).

Non-negotiable: Any request that exposes Redwood to indefinite annual onsite audit commitments or indefinite egress exceptions is not acceptable. If EdgeWave wants more than the one onsite in year one, they pay for the excess or move to a higher support tier.

Laura: proceed to present this to Anita. Rishi: lock these guardrails into the commercial memo and update pricing sheet. Aditya: confirm infra follow-through and an estimated schedule for provisioning. Legal: prepare DPA redline.

Marcus Lin
VP, Sales & Partnerships
Redwood Inference
From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: Anita Singh <anita.singh@edgewave.com>, procurement@edgewave.com
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 23 Aug 2026 15:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: VPC deployment, EU residency + ask for onboarding credit

Hi Anita — great news and thanks for the quick turnaround. Per Marcus' executive approval, Redwood can proceed with the pilot under the following terms (high level):

- Hosting & Residency: Production runs in a Frankfurt VPC with a 12-month residency lock; automatic cross-region backups will be disabled for 12 months. We will include explicit DPA language to that effect.
- Audits & Evidence: Redwood will support remote evidence collection with a 30-day notice SLA. EdgeWave is allowed one onsite-assisted audit in the first 12 months (60-day scheduling notice). Any additional onsite audits will be billed per our support rate card; Deal Desk will share the estimate.
- Commercial: Redwood will apply a 20% discount to hosting fees for the first 3 months of the pilot and a one-time $25,000 migration support credit. This concession is conditional on: (1) signed pilot SOW and (2) acceptance of the audit guardrails above.

Next steps:
1) I'll attach the pilot SOW and send to your procurement team for signature (DocuSign link to follow).
2) Rishi will provide the Deal Desk pricing memo and the operational estimate for onsite audit effort.
3) Aditya will reach out to schedule the provisioning window; we'll reserve two infra engineers for the pilot onboarding week.

Can you confirm procurement's acceptance of the guardrails by EOD Friday? If yes, we'll activate the DocuSign flow and lock the provisioning week.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this started.

Laura Bennett
Senior AE, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
